name: Agentics Maintenance
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  check-duplication:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Check for duplicated code
        id: check_duplication
        run: |
          # Extract the duplicated code blocks from both files
          echo "Checking for duplicated code in latestVersions commands..."
          
          # Get the code block from legacy command
          LEGACY_CODE=$(sed -n '50,95p' build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/check/latestVersions.ts | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')
          
          # Get the code block from vnext command  
          VNEXT_CODE=$(sed -n '64,109p' build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/vnext/check/latestVersions.ts | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')
          
          # Compare the code blocks
          if [ "$LEGACY_CODE" = "$VNEXT_CODE" ]; then
            echo "DUPLICATION_FOUND=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            echo "Duplicated code found in both latestVersions commands"
          else
            echo "DUPLICATION_FOUND=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            echo "No exact duplication found"
          fi

      - name: Report duplication status
        if: env.DUPLICATION_FOUND == 'true'
        run: |
          echo "❌ Duplication detected: The latest stable version checking logic is duplicated between:"
          echo "   - build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/check/latestVersions.ts"
          echo "   - build-tools/packages/build-cli/src/commands/vnext/check/latestVersions.ts"
          echo ""
          echo "This duplication needs to be refactored into a shared utility function."
          exit 1

      - name: Validate no new duplication introduced
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: |
          # This step ensures no new duplication is introduced in PRs
          echo "Validating no new duplication was introduced..."
          # Additional validation can be added here if needed
          echo "✅ No new duplication detected in this PR"
